name: EMA Crossover + MACD + RSI Confirmation - Optimized (5min)
description: Long: Price above EMA 50, EMA 9 crosses above 21, MACD histogram crosses up, RSI crosses above 50. Exit on RSI overbought, EMA cross reversal, or hard stop. Short: inverse.

conditions.comment: Price above EMA 50 - establishes bullish bias (persistent filter)
EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 - short-term momentum shift (primary trigger)
RSI crosses above 50 - final confirmation (must fire within 3 candles)
RSI crosses down from 70 - overbought exhaustion
EMA 9 crosses below EMA 21 - short-term trend reversal
Price crosses below EMA 50 - hard stop loss, trend invalidated
MACD signal line crosses down - momentum fully reversed
Price below EMA 50 - establishes bearish bias (persistent filter)
EMA 9 crosses below EMA 21 - short-term momentum shift (primary trigger)
RSI crosses below 50 - final confirmation (must fire within 3 candles)
RSI crosses up from 30 - oversold bounce
EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 - short-term trend reversal
Price crosses above EMA 50 - hard stop loss, trend invalidated
MACD signal line crosses up - momentum fully reversed
